## Task

You are investigating what happens when FastAPI registers a route in fastapi/routing.py. Starting from `APIRoute.__init__`, trace the causal pipeline that turns a decorated endpoint function into a fully-configured route: how its response type is introspected, how its full dependency tree is built and flattened, and how its request-body field is constructed.

First give a short (2-4 sentence) explanation of the pipeline.

Then, on its own line, emit a fenced JSON code block containing an ordered array of the fully-qualified symbol names in that causal order - only symbols actually present in the provided context package may appear.


## Response format

Respond with a single fenced JSON object and nothing else:
```json
{"reasoning": "<short explanation>", "symbols": ["<fully.qualified.name>", "..."]}
```
`symbols` lists every code symbol that is part of your answer, in order, by exact fully-qualified name.
